added.title: Director, Product Development Engineering - Optics
added.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

AI and hyperscale computing are fundamentally changing data-center architecture, making optics increasingly critical to how advanced systems connect and scale.

TE Connectivity is developing the next generation of optical interconnect technologies, spanning fiber connectivity and structured cabling, free-space optics, precision optical interfaces, and high-volume manufacturing solutions.

The Director, Product Development Engineering will build and rapidly scale a world-class engineering organization with the talent, technical capabilities, processes, and infrastructure required to support the extraordinary growth of AI and hyperscale infrastructure. This leader will establish the engineering vision and operating model, strengthen technical and organizational capabilities, and develop the next generation of engineering leaders

The role spans free-space optics, fiber connectivity and structured cabling, precision optical and mechanical systems, plastics and polymers, metals, glass and optical materials, precision assembly, and high-volume manufacturing for AI, hyperscale data-center, optical communications, and high-performance computing applications.

Location: There is a strong preference for the selected candidate to be based in Rochester, NY and be able to work in a hybrid setting. We will offer relocation for the selected candidate if needed.

Key Responsibilities

Build and scale the engineering organization, including organizational structure, talent, capabilities, capacity, and strategic investments.
Establish clear engineering direction, processes, technical standards, and decision-making practices that improve speed, quality, and overall effectiveness.
Develop the technologies, platforms, processes, and reusable engineering capabilities needed to rapidly address emerging customer and market opportunities.
Balance near-term customer and product-development priorities with longer-term technology exploration, capability development, and risk reduction.
Translate advanced technologies and innovative concepts into practical, reliable, cost-effective products and scalable, high-volume manufacturing solutions.
Develop and mentor Sr. Managers, emerging engineering leaders, and technical experts while strengthening succession and creating opportunities for career growth.
Foster collaboration across TE’s global engineering, manufacturing, materials, automation, and technology organizations to leverage capabilities, expertise, and best practices.
Build and maintain a strong external technology ecosystem across strategic suppliers, equipment and process partners, technology and IP providers, and specialized engineering resources.
Partner closely with Product Management, Operations, Manufacturing, customers, and senior leadership to align technical strategy with business and market priorities.
Establish an engineering organization recognized for technical depth, execution, innovation, process excellence, and the ability to scale.

What Your Background Should Look Like

Bachelor’s degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
Typically 15+ years of engineering or product-development experience, including significant progressive engineering leadership experience.
Proven success building and leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations through significant growth, transformation, or change.
Strong technical foundation across relevant areas such as optics, fiber connectivity, precision mechanical systems, materials, plastics, metals, glass, precision manufacturing, or high-volume assembly.
Technical depth and judgment to challenge assumptions, assess technical risk, guide complex decisions, and earn the credibility of experienced engineers and technical experts.
Demonstrated ability to improve engineering effectiveness through organizational design, talent and capability development, processes, tools, and disciplined technical decision-making.
Experience translating emerging or advanced technologies into practical products and scalable manufacturing approaches.
Experience in fast-moving technology markets such as hyperscale data centers, optical communications, high-performance computing, or semiconductor technology strongly preferred.
Proven ability to build productive internal and external technical networks across customers, suppliers, technology partners, manufacturing organizations, and global engineering teams.
Strong business judgment, communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to balance immediate execution needs with longer-term technology strategy and capability development.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

#TEOpticsJobs #USOpticsJobs

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

About Te Connectivity

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

Compensation

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $203,800 – 305,700 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

Benefits

A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

added.description:
Job Description

If you are a software engineering leader ready to take the reins and drive impact, we've got an opportunity just for you.

As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Operations Collections, you lead a technical area and drive impact within teams, technologies, and projects across departments. Utilize your in-depth knowledge of software, applications, technical processes, and product management to drive multiple complex projects and initiatives, while serving as a primary decision maker for your teams and be a driver of innovation and solution delivery.

Job Responsibilities

Leads technology and process implementations to achieve functional technology objectives
Accountable for decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution and implementation of processes and procedures
Sets direction and governance for agentic AI-enabled engineering and SDLC/TLM automation within a technical area to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-orchestrated delivery workflows, release readiness controls, automated test modernization, and incident triage acceleration), while establishing guardrails for validation, security, resiliency, traceability, and reuse across teams.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation and support capacity unlock initiatives at scale.
Carries governance accountability for coding decisions, control obligations, and measures of success such as cost of ownership, maintainability, and portfolio operations
Delivers technical solutions that can be leveraged across multiple businesses and domains
Influences peer leaders and senior stakeholders across the business, product, and technology teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 10+ years applied experience. In addition, 5+ years of experience leading technologists to manage, anticipate and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
Experience developing or leading cross-functional teams of technologists
Experience with hiring, developing, and recognizing talent
Experience leading adoption of agentic AI-enabled engineering practices (using enterprise-authorized tools within the work environment) across teams, including defining operating expectations (human-in-the-loop validation, quality gates), measuring outcomes, and ensuring secure handling of sensitive inputs/outputs.
Strong understanding of responsible AI use and control expectations in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity, resiliency/security implications, and governance; ability to influence leaders on safe scaling patterns and reuse.
Practical cloud native experience
Expertise in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. added.description:

As Director of Engineering, you’ll lead the maintenance and engineering operations of the property, ensuring all building systems, equipment, and facilities operate safely and efficiently. You’ll manage a team, oversee preventative maintenance programs, and ensure compliance with safety and brand standards. This role is ideal for a hands-on leader with strong technical expertise and a commitment to maintaining a well-functioning, guest-ready environment.

Key Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)

You will be the backbone of our hotel's operations, ensuring all systems and equipment run smoothly for our guests' comfort and safety.
Your daily tasks will include managing maintenance staff, overseeing repairs and upgrades, and ensuring compliance with safety regulations and codes.
You will report to the General Manager.
Maintain complete knowledge of and comply with all departmental policies/service
procedures/standards.
Maintain complete knowledge of correct maintenance and use of equipment. Use equipment only as intended.
Anticipate guests’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all guests, however busy and at any time of day.
Maintain positive guest relations at all times.
Resolve guest complaints, ensuring guest satisfaction.
Monitor and maintain cleanliness, sanitation and organization of assigned work areas.
Develop and implement a preventive maintenance program of all-building equipment and guestrooms, including the training of the Property Operations staff on the management of such a program.
Maintain inventory of all parts and supplies.
Purchase all parts, supplies, tools and equipment related to Property Operations through direct contact with sales representatives.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of all: heaters, pumps, valves and lines used in the distribution of steam and heated or processed water.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of all: refrigerant compressors, condensers, evaporators, traps, transfer pumps, expansion valves, stop valves as well as all refrigerant lines and devices used to control temperatures.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of chillers, cooling tower, elevators and related mechanical equipment, pools, spas and fitness equipment, laundry/related equipment, kitchen equipment, air compressors, gas and distribution lines and valves/devices, water filters/softners/piping/pumps, sinks/toilets/bowls as well as supply and water lines.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of all types of motors or engines used to power pumps, compressors and fans.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of all types of locks, keys and locksmith related duties, including guestroom key card locks.
Ensure the proper operation, maintenance and repair of all electrical devices and equipment.
Coordinate the maintenance repair and installation of carpentry work, and those duties related to carpentry.
Prepare and adjust weekly work schedules in accordance with staffing guidelines and labor forecasts.
Adjust work goals and schedules throughout the week to meet the business demands.
Monitor staff performance in all phases of job functions ensuring that all procedures are carried out to departmental standards; rectify any deficiencies with respective personnel.
Plan capital expenditures and execute projects.
Conduct monthly department meetings.

Education & Experience

A college degree or two years of hotel experience
Previous experience in this exact position
Previous experience in a similar or related position
A combination of education and experience
Desirable Experience:
Five years training as a stationary Engineer. Five years supervisory experience Working knowledge of: Plumbing codes Electrical codes, National/local fire codes, Local mechanical codes Water treatment program, Blue prints and plumbing and wiring schematics, Power and hand tools, meters, etc. as it relates to the technical trades, Abatement precautionary measures, Knowledge of all mechanical equipment critical to the operation of the building.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Eligible to work in the United States
Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English
Ability to sit, stand, bend, kneel, and lift as required—with or without reasonable accommodations
Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays if needed
A warm, professional demeanor that reflects HVMG’s Culture of Excellence

This position may require a varied schedule, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Please share your scheduling needs.

Why Our Associates Love HVMG

Career growth opportunities across our nationwide portfolio
Flexible scheduling
Access up to 40% of your earned wages before payday with PayActive
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
Full healthcare benefits: medical, dental, and vision
401(k) with guaranteed 4% match and no vesting period
Exclusive hotel and food & beverage discounts

About HVMG

Our Be Excellent culture is more than just words on a website -- we live and breathe it. As one associate said in an anonymous survey, "This is the best management company I've ever worked for. They walk the talk from the corporate office to the field."

We believe that the hotel business is one of the few industries in which successful career paths can start anywhere on the org chart. You control your destiny, and, if our executives are any indication, today's dishwasher can be tomorrow's Senior Vice President.

.

added.title: Director, Engineering – Agentic Product
added.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As the Director of Engineering, Agentic Product, you will lead the technical execution of Adobe's Agentic Product: the AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together into a coherent, high-quality product for creators used by hundreds of millions of people every day. You'll partner directly with Product leadership to define, build, and ship agentic experiences that meaningfully change how creators work.

You'll be responsible for the end-to-end product quality of the agent: its capabilities, its behaviors, and the experience it delivers across surfaces. This is a focused, product-minded engineering leadership role — you are accountable for what the agent does and how well it works, not for the underlying platform or ecosystem packaging.

This is a rare opportunity to build a new, AI-native engineering team and practices that will define Adobe's most visible AI product. The right person brings experience leading engineering teams that ship high-quality, user-facing AI experiences, a strong point of view on what "great" looks like for creative AI, and the ability to raise the bar in a space that is moving fast.

Senior Director-level may be considered for those with the right experience and technical depth.

What You'll Do

Lead the engineering execution of Adobe's Agentic Product — collaborating to define what the agent does, driving the quality of its outputs, and ensuring it ships on a predictable cadence across surfaces.
Grow and lead the engineering team building Agentic Product capabilities, driving technical strategy, team health, and execution velocity.
Partner closely with the Agentic Product Management leads to define technical scope, sequence delivery, and translate product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Lead the design and delivery of agent capabilities spanning in-app creative workflows, multi-step task execution, and context-aware assistance across Adobe's surfaces.
Establish and maintain the quality bar for agent behavior — what good looks like, how it's measured, and how the team systematically improves it over time.
Partner across Adobe's platform and infrastructure teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built with appropriate evals, guardrails, data protection, and the reliability expected of a product at Adobe's scale.
Build and maintain fluency across the emerging agentic standards and model capabilities ecosystem and ensure Adobe's Agentic Product engineering practices evolve with the space.

What You'll Need To Succeed

A track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams to ship complex, high-quality user-facing AI products at scale.
Deep experience with AI/ML product engineering, including working knowledge of LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and the capabilities and limitations of current generative models in creative contexts.
Hands-on technical expertise: you can engage deeply in architecture decisions, review designs with a substantive point of view, and recognize good and brittle agent behavior at the implementation level — not just the product level. You remain close to the code and the craft.
Strong product sensibility — you have intuitions about user experience, you can look at agent behavior and know when it's good or brittle, and you partner with PM and design as a peer, not a downstream executor.
Strong cross-functional leadership instincts with a history of effective partnership with Product, Design, and platform engineering teams.
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the technology, the competitive dynamics, and the user expectations are all rapidly evolving.
Experience with the quality, reliability, and trust requirements that come with shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience.
Demonstrated ability to lead change management and drive continuous innovation in engineering processes and practices — helping teams adopt new ways of working, internalize new tooling, and stay ahead of a rapidly shifting technical landscape without losing execution focus.
Experience working with LLM providers or contributing to AI product strategy is strongly preferred.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to guide the development of AI-native, production-ready machine learning products for external clients. This leader will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of sophisticated AI systems—from product conception and rollout to production, customer engagement, and continuous operational success.

This role requires a rare blend of hands‑on technical depth, product judgment, and senior‑level people leadership. You will lead a highly experienced ML engineering organization and work closely with Product, Development, and Go‑to‑Market partners to bring differentiated AI solutions to market.

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Product Leadership

Own the end‑to‑end delivery of AI/ML solutions deployed in production, moving beyond proofs‑of‑concept to scalable, reliable, customer‑facing systems.
Lead deep technical discussions on system build, model integration, performance, reliability, and operational readiness.
Collaborate directly with Product Management to build product vision, challenge assumptions, and ensure differentiation beyond general‑purpose LLM capabilities.
Drive architectural decisions that balance innovation, scalability, cost, and long‑term maintainability.
Act as a senior technical voice with customers, handling partner concerns, roadmap discussions, and production issue resolution.

Team & Organizational Leadership

Establish, grow, and manage a high-caliber ML engineering organization, scaling the team from about 4 to over 20 engineers as time progresses.
Manage and mentor senior engineers and leaders with 16+ years of experience, encouraging accountability, ownership, and continuous growth.
Establish a flat, hands‑on, hybrid operating model where leaders stay close to the work while empowering teams to implement initiatives independently.
Conduct performance management, career development, and succession planning aligned to director‑level expectations.

Drive strong engineering rigor across testing, release readiness, and post‑launch support.
Build scalable processes that support rapid iteration while maintaining enterprise‑grade reliability.

Ability to engage deeply with product partners and debate technical and product tradeoffs in fast paced environments.
